## What's Changed * feat(voice): user voice vocabulary in Settings; no built-in product terms by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/350 * perf(mac): modern SecKey for process-local keys (~6x cheaper decrypt); release 0.2.50 by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/353
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/compare/v0.35.0...mac-v0.2.50

## What's Changed * feat(diag): stability summaries — opening, outages, sending, voice, conversation opens by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/342 * fix(tentacle): recover pi model list after a failed startup read by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/341 * fix(voice): a failed correction still sends the raw transcript by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/343 * Kraki for Mac includes Kraki: set up without Terminal by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/344 * chore(release): protocol 0.24.0 for Tentacle 0.34.0 by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/345
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/compare/mac-v0.2.48...mac-v0.2.49

## What's Changed * fix: fragment large payloads so slow links keep showing progress by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/332 * fix(native): no Reconnecting flash on foreground; multi-device + background resilience scenarios by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/333 * fix(web): web client network resilience (W0–W5 chaos scenarios) by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/334 * fix: soak-found delivery bugs (greeting features, stall clock) + netem/soak on CI by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/335 * fix(web): name the sender so duplicate inputs are re-echoed; soak harness + diagnostics by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/336 * chore(ci): drop web network-resilience job and nightly web soak by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/337 * chore(ci): no nightly network-resilience run (manual only) by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/338 * fix(tentacle): stop deleting images users sent; remove the legacy inline-image migration by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/340 * fix(mac): recover sign-in after a slow gh or failed Keychain challenge; release 0.2.48 by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/339
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/compare/v0.33.4...mac-v0.2.48
